The '''Great Kessel Fault''' was located on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. It was very large and threatened to tear the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] apart when Kessel's [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] were becoming too large in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].
